parsed.rationale: All four types — AccentHueKey, AccentSaturationKey, AccentBrightnessKey, and LCDActiveBrightnessKey — are structurally identical SwiftUI EnvironmentKey boilerplate types living in the same file (AccentColorEnvironment.swift, package PlayerHeaderView) with shared_field_count of 1 and no differing slots. The only variation between them is their name and the associated default value/type, which are exactly the parameters a Swift macro could accept. A single `@EnvironmentKey` attached macro would synthesize the conformance body, eliminating all four hand-written types and making future additions a one-liner.

specifics.synthesizes: A SwiftUI EnvironmentKey-conforming struct with a default `defaultValue` property, eliminating the need to hand-write each boilerplate key type. Each invocation would expand to a struct conforming to EnvironmentKey with a caller-supplied default value and type.
